title: Research Gap Discovery Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Underexplored questions, literature coverage, unresolved findings, and candidate research directions. The Research Gap Discovery Database finds the questions nobody is asking: where literature coverage is thin, where findings conflict without resolution, where methods exist but have never been applied to a domain. Each gap record shows the evidence of the gap (what was searched, what was found, what is missing), why it matters, and what a study addressing it would look like. Science advances into gaps — this database maps them.

title: Research Gap Discovery Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Gap types: empty (no work), thin (little work), contradictory (disagreeing work), stale (old work, new context), transfer (method exists elsewhere). Evidence method: systematic search (databases, queries, date ranges — all recorded), coverage matrix (sub-topics x methods, cell = paper count), citation analysis (who cites whom; isolated clusters suggest gaps). Significance: who cares, what changes if answered, what it unblocks. Tractability: methods exist, data obtainable, skills available. Prioritization: score = importance * tractability * novelty, weights stated. Study sketch: question, approach, expected contribution, first three steps. Anti-patterns: gap-as-complaint (no direction), gap-that-is-not (missed literature — the search strategy guards), trivial gaps.

title: Research Gap Discovery Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: coverage test (matrices complete and counts correct); scoring test (rankings match the scoring function); search test (strategies cover the claimed databases); determinism test. Limitations: corpus-dependent — stated per record; significance needs experts; novelty decays as fields move. Every gap record shows its search strategy and date.

demo.code: const opts={A:{perf:9,rel:6,simple:5},B:{perf:6,rel:9,simple:8}};const w={perf:0.5,rel:0.3,simple:0.2};function score(o){return o.perf*w.perf+o.rel*w.rel+o.simple*w.simple;}const sA=score(opts.A),sB=score(opts.B);const w2={perf:0.3,rel:0.5,simple:0.2};function score2(o){return o.perf*w2.perf+o.rel*w2.rel+o.simple*w2.simple;}const flip=score2(opts.B)>score2(opts.A);J({sA:+sA.toFixed(2),sB:+sB.toFixed(2),flip});assert(sA>sB&&flip,'tradeoff');
